# Machine: Apple M4 Max (Mac16,6)

# Go: go1.26.2
# Swift: release (SwiftUIBridge, embedded)
# Bridge: internal/embeddedbridge/libSwiftUIBridge.dylib
# go test -run='^$' -bench='^Benchmark(LeafText|LeafSpacer|LeafImage|ContainerBuild|ContainerBuildReuse|ContainerBuildNoReuse)$' -benchmem -count=10 -benchtime=2s .
# Post-P6a: container constructors pull a scratch []uintptr from the
# view_builder arena (view_builder.go). Inline capacity [16]uintptr
# covers the common case; larger containers spill to a retained
# overflow buffer (capped at 128 entries to avoid pinning outsize
# allocations). Per-call allocation drops from 5 → 4 on every
# container variant; byte-count drops are proportional (53-70% on
# the Reuse and NoReuse paths). Leaf benchmarks (Text/Spacer/Image)
# are unchanged because the *retained allocation and the purego
# reflect.MakeFunc trampoline allocs are outside this slice's scope.
#
